title: [Decision] Scheduled and bot workflows: the 4-hourly lint run repeats the push run, four daily patrols are four workflows, four PR-body guards are four runners — consolidate, and to what cadence
body:
Ruled: 6416984681 · letter A · 2026-10-26T13:18Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「完整的评估本项目， 还有哪些可以优化的地方。包括 ci 和文档」 then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue，需要决策的立为决策卡。」 and 「低优先级的先不考虑」. Batch-of: 19 (repository evaluation 2026-10-26, `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`; 9 decision cards + 10 execution cards). Reader: the director seat presents this card in a decision batch; after the ruling the lane named under "After the ruling" dispatches. ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: REST list (439 issues), grep `schedule|cron|patrol` → 13 hits; on topic only #25771 (closed: CI and Lint every 4 h instead of hourly, CodeQL daily) and #25991 (open: project seats create their own patrol routine). Neither covers lint's schedule duplicating push, merging the four patrols, or merging the four PR-body guards. **New.**

## 维护者速读

39 个 workflow 里 19 个是 PM、车队、机器人类（49%），每天约 36 次定时触发。三处可合：① `lint.yml` 每 4 小时全量一次，但 main 上每次 push 已经跑全部门禁族（`scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh` 头注「push on main … keep the whole battery」），main 一天约 87 次 merge，定时那次几乎总是重复刚跑过的 sha；② 四个日巡逻 watchdog / release-coverage / required-set / board-snapshot 各是一个 workflow 文件各自 checkout + setup；③ 四个只解析 PR 正文的守卫（closing-target-claim、duplicate-fix、partof-closing-keyword、single-claim-path）各自是一个 workflow，每次 opened/edited/synchronize 各占一个 runner。合并是节奏与车队形态的决定，#25771 的「每 4 小时」是你 10 月 23 日裁的。请裁：**A** lint 的定时运行改为「HEAD 已有绿 push run 即跳过」，四巡逻合一文件多 job，四守卫合一 job 四 step；**B** 只做 ③ 守卫合并，节奏不动；**C** 全部保持现状。选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- `.github/workflows/lint.yml:48-49` and `ci.yml:63-64`: `cron: '0 */4 * * *'` (ruling on #25771, maintainer Q6 = C: every 4 hours, not hourly).
- `scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh` header: a push on main keeps the whole battery.
- Patrol crons: `required-set-patrol.yml:96` `23 4,16 * * *`; `platform-checklist-watchdog.yml:112` `51 2 * * *`; `release-coverage-patrol.yml:110` `19 4 * * *`; `board-snapshot.yml:165` `7 2,8,14,20 * * *`.
- Guard triggers: `closing-target-claim-guard.yml:54`, `duplicate-fix-guard.yml:25`, `partof-closing-keyword-guard.yml:34`, `single-claim-path-guard.yml:46`: `types: [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize]`.
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14: `.github/workflows/**` is Tier H.
- Triage rule 「花费/配额/舰队形态」 is a human-floor item, which is why this is a decision card and not an execution card.

## Premises

- P1 — lint's scheduled run adds nothing when the push run on the same sha is green. Re-check: compare the last 7 days of `lint.yml` `schedule` runs against the `push` run on the same `head_sha` via `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/lint.yml/runs?event=schedule`.
- P2 — the four guards parse only the PR body and need no checkout of the tree. Re-check: read each guard's steps; all four run `actions/checkout` + `setup-node` before a script that reads `github.event.pull_request.body`.
- P3 — ci.yml's scheduled run is NOT the same case: it computes `--affected` on push and only the schedule runs the full battery (ci.yml:41-62). This card leaves ci.yml's schedule alone.

## One-sentence problem

Runner minutes and queue slots are spent six times a day re-linting a commit that was linted when it landed, and twelve workflow files do work four files could do.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | (i) lint.yml schedule: a first step checks for a completed green `push` run on `github.sha` and skips the battery if found; (ii) one `fleet-patrols.yml` with four jobs on the existing crons; (iii) one `pr-body-guards.yml`, one job, four steps. | Fewer runner minutes, fewer files to read; the required-check set is untouched (none of these publish a required context — verify with `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`). | devx/skills · 3 PRs, all Tier H · precedent: #25771 (cadence change, closed) |
| B | Only (iii). | Smallest change; the patrol and schedule spend stays. | devx · 1 PR Tier H |
| C | Nothing. | Status quo. | 0 |

## Business meaning

- A: the fleet pays for what it uses; one file per concern.
- B: the cheapest visible saving, the rest deferred.
- C: accept the spend as the price of independence between patrols.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：定时 lint 一天 6 次、每次 14 个 job 约 445 分钟超时预算；四守卫每个 PR 事件 4 个 runner。这些分钟与 PR、队列抢同一池 runner，#25870 量到核心 PR 已经在等。
- **项目长远合理性**：巡逻与守卫按「一个关切一个文件」长出来，是车队快速演化的自然形态；合并后文件少、注释少（这些文件注释占 60–74%），但每个巡逻的独立失败信号要保留（job 级，不是 step 级）。
- **防 AI 犯错**：合并本身不改任何判定逻辑，是搬运；风险在搬运时漏掉一个 `if:` 或权限块。派发令要求逐文件 diff 对照旧文件，权限按 job 最小化。
- **创业阶段不扩散**：减文件、减触发，不加门禁。A 的 (i) 加一个「跳过」步骤，是减法。

## Recommendation

**A.** 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

Confidence gaps: whether any of the four guards also carries a `merge_group` trigger that the queue waits on (closing-target-claim-guard does: line 57; the merged file must keep it).

## After the ruling

- A or B: the skills lane (PM-protocol workflows are `domain:skills` per the lane table) dispatches; three PRs in A so each is reviewable; all Tier H.
- C: close not planned.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：按关切合文件，巡逻保留 job 级独立信号，不增加例外。
② 实际业务拉动：runner 池与 PR、队列共享，#25870 量到核心 PR 已在等；定时 lint 重复 push。
③ 防 AI 犯错：纯搬运，派发令要求逐文件 diff 对照与 job 级最小权限。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：减文件减触发，零新门禁。
Prior rulings read: schedule,cron,patrol,guard → 2 hits (#25771 cadence, #25991 seat patrol); none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack
